environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' (KEP-2579). The restricted profile denies: privileged containers, hostPath volumes, runAsNonRoot must be true, capabilities drop ALL, seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' with validationFailureAction=Enforce exists as defense-in-depth. The namespace also carries annotation 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.28'. Service account has minimal RBAC (only get/list on its own namespace configmaps). Calico NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to port 50051 from labeled frontend pods only (podSelector matchLabels: tier=frontend, namespaceSelector matchLabels: zone=dmz).

config.volumes: no hostPath permitted by PSS restricted
config.network_policy: Calico ingress only from tier=frontend in zone=dmz namespace to port 50051
config.rbac: get/list configmaps in own namespace only
